description: Java source code for SigfoxProtocolAdapter class, a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for Sigfox backend communication within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: SigfoxProtocolAdapter
classes.description: Main class implementing a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for Sigfox backend communication, handling message upload, command validation, and request routing.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name identifier for this protocol adapter, e.g., 'sigfox'.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Configures HTTP routes for telemetry and event data, including authorization setup.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for device authentication based on username and password.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider to determine tenant and auth ID from HTTP context.

methods.name: setupAuthorization
methods.description: Configures authorization handlers for the router.

methods.name: getTenantTraceSamplingHandler
methods.description: Provides tenant and trace sampling handler with fallback implementation.

methods.name: dataHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming data requests, validates tenant info, and processes payload.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Adds 'sigfox.'-prefixed query parameters to downstream message application properties.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.description: Decodes hex-encoded data string into a Buffer.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnectFromRequest
methods.description: Determines the time until disconnect based on 'ack' query param or header.

methods.name: isCommandValid
methods.description: Validates command object for size, one-way property, and payload presence.

methods.name: setEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets HTTP response for no-content ACK.

methods.name: setNonEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets HTTP response with command payload as JSON.

methods.name: convertToResponsePayload
methods.description: Converts command payload to JSON buffer for response.
